title: NetEase Cloud Music Scraper Input
description: Search NetEase Cloud Music, fetch songs, lyrics, artists, albums, playlists, all charts and comments. No login or proxy setup required.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: What to fetch. Each mode reads its own list field.
enumTitles: Search songs, albums, artists or playlists
Song details by URL or ID (with lyrics)
One or more charts (or all charts)

searchQueries.title: Search queries
searchQueries.description: Free-text queries (mode=search). One or more artist, song, album or playlist names.

searchType.title: Search result type
searchType.description: Which catalog entity to search for (mode=search).

songUrls.title: Song URLs or IDs (mode=bySongUrl)
songUrls.description: music.163.com song URLs or bare song IDs, e.g. 186016.

artistIds.title: Artist IDs, URLs or names (mode=byArtist / byArtistAlbums)
artistIds.description: Artist IDs, music.163.com artist URLs, or exact artist names.

artistOrder.title: Artist song order
artistOrder.description: Order the artist's song catalogue by popularity or release time (mode=byArtist).

albumUrls.title: Album URLs or IDs (mode=byAlbum)
albumUrls.description: music.163.com album URLs or bare album IDs.

playlistUrls.title: Playlist URLs or IDs (mode=byPlaylistUrl)
playlistUrls.description: music.163.com playlist URLs or bare playlist IDs. Full tracklists are read.

playlistCat.title: Playlist category
playlistCat.description: NetEase playlist genre, scene or mood to browse (mode=byPlaylist).

toplistIds.title: Chart IDs, names or URLs (mode=byToplist)
toplistIds.description: Chart IDs, music.163.com toplist URLs, or Chinese/English chart names. Use `all` or leave empty for every current chart.

maxTracksPerChart.title: Max tracks per chart
maxTracksPerChart.description: Limit tracks read from each chart before the global max items cap (mode=byToplist). 0 reads every track.

commentUrls.title: Comment targets (mode=comments)
commentUrls.description: Song, album, playlist or chart URLs/IDs. A bare ID is treated as a song; use `album:123`, `playlist:123` or `chart:123` to be explicit.

commentOrder.title: Comment order
commentOrder.description: Recommended comments or NetEase's hot-comment selection (mode=comments).

maxCommentsPerItem.title: Max comments per resource
maxCommentsPerItem.description: Maximum top-level comments read per song, album, playlist or chart (mode=comments). NetEase stops anonymous pagination around 1,100.

includeReplies.title: Include comment replies
includeReplies.description: Fetch the reply floor for comments that have replies (mode=comments).

maxRepliesPerComment.title: Max replies per comment
maxRepliesPerComment.description: How many replies to read for each comment when replies are enabled (mode=comments).

includeArtistProfile.title: Include artist profile
includeArtistProfile.description: Emit one artist profile record with bio, images, sizes, rank, identities and fan count (mode=byArtist / byArtistAlbums).

includeLyrics.title: Include lyrics
includeLyrics.description: Attach full LRC lyrics plus translation, romanization and word-by-word lyrics when NetEase has them (every song mode).

includeAlbumTracks.title: Include album tracks
includeAlbumTracks.description: Emit each album's tracks as song records (mode=byAlbum).

includePlaylistTracks.title: Include playlist tracks
includePlaylistTracks.description: Emit the playlist's full tracklist as song records (mode=byPlaylistUrl).

includeToplistInfo.title: Include chart summary
includeToplistInfo.description: Emit a chart summary record before each chart's tracks (mode=byToplist).

minDurationSec.title: Min song duration (seconds)
minDurationSec.description: Skip song records shorter than this. Album, artist, playlist and chart metadata are unaffected.

maxDurationSec.title: Max song duration (seconds)
maxDurationSec.description: Skip song records longer than this. Album, artist, playlist and chart metadata are unaffected.

minPopularity.title: Min song popularity
minPopularity.description: Skip song records below this NetEase popularity score (0-100). Metadata records are unaffected.

minPlayCount.title: Min playlist plays
minPlayCount.description: Skip browsed playlists with fewer plays (mode=byPlaylist).

minTrackCount.title: Min playlist tracks
minTrackCount.description: Skip browsed playlists with fewer tracks (mode=byPlaylist).

containsKeyword.title: Contains keyword
containsKeyword.description: Keep only records whose name contains this text (case-insensitive). Applies to songs, albums, artists, playlists and charts.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Hard cap on total dataset records for the run, including error records.
